title: Design the core model: paper tooth, pigment deposit, media
description: Decide how paper (tooth height field, fibres), dry media (graphite, coloured pencil, charcoal, pastel, crayon, wax/oil-based) and their deposit, smudging, burnishing and erasing are represented, and how the result is lit. Reuse what fits from oilpaint (spectral Kubelka-Munk mixing, noise, PNG output). Add numba when the first kernel lands.

title: Set up the project
description: Packaging (hatch, hatch-vcs, PyPI-ready metadata), uv, black, ruff, pyright, pytest, coverage with Codecov, cspell, tox, Makefile, CI, PyPI publish workflow, Dependabot, Beads, minimal AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md. Mirrors oilpaint.

title: Connect Codecov and PyPI trusted publishing
description: Human steps outside the repo: enable joce/fusain on Codecov (CI uploads with OIDC, no token), add a pending PyPI trusted publisher (project fusain, owner joce, repo fusain, workflow publish.yml, environment pypi) and create the pypi environment on GitHub with a required reviewer. See RELEASING.md.
close_reason: Codecov enabled (OIDC uploads), PyPI pending trusted publisher added, pypi environment has a required reviewer
